verdict.rationale: gstack stores cross-session learnings locally at ~/.gstack/projects/{slug}/learnings.jsonl, and its own /learn skill lets users review, search, prune and export them, which gives first-party deletion control over that store. Coverage stops there: nothing documents retention policies or deletion for other persisted data such as domain-skill notes or telemetry. The telemetry opt-out mentioned by the community controls collection, not retention or deletion, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented retention settings or policies, deletion controls for domain skills and any collected telemetry data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of pruning.
